baseline.method: Independent minimally corrected QSM.m SSTGV, paper-based physical regularization, full raw-phase volume

reference_identity: Standard-method result; not actual biological truth. COSMOS/STI independent imperfect measurements appear only in maintainer scientific comparisons.
comparison_mask: Public acquisition brain mask for array agreement/eta RMS; six-neighbor interior for PDE.
pde_definition: norm(L(residual_phase)-W(PHASE_PER_PPM*reconstruction)-wrapped_L(phase)) / norm(wrapped_L(phase)), on the public six-neighbor interior.
tolerance_provenance: Boundaries frozen from independent C reruns and full-state double-precision parity; full CUDA validation pending at freeze time and must pass before completion. Nonzero 1e-5 range-normalized tolerance is a conservative numerical floor; thresholds may not be relaxed after the fresh run. Full CUDA validation subsequently passed without changing these frozen boundaries; see test/validation.md and archived full_cuda_parity.json.
joint_objective_definition: 0.5 sum_mask(eta/s)^2 + .00075 sum_interior ||grad chi-w||_2 + .00025 sum_interior ||Ew||F. chi ppm, eta rad, w ppm/mm; s=2pi42.58*2.89362*.025rad/ppm. Original PDE/eta limits unchanged. Full feasible standard witness objective plus relative1e-8 numerical allowance; no hidden map agreement.
